answer: Each agent bonds stake to a Semaphore identity and evaluates the epoch polynomial to derive a secret share for its rate-limit proof. A message carries a zero-knowledge membership proof and nullifier, not the share itself. Reusing a nullifier within the epoch exposes two polynomial evaluations; Shamir interpolation recovers the private RLN key, enabling verification and instantaneous slashing of the bond. A jetty may carry the signal, while a vine analogy captures how shares connect to the secret.
